The main takeaway from our work is that

the INT3-SDP is a flexible, modular and reusable methodology, which allows the analysts to describe the environment to be analysed, the sensors to be deployed and the software modules to be implemented in a systematic and standardised way.
INT3-SDP can be used for the specification of any kind of sensor-based system, including those that do not require the use of artificial intelligence techniques.

it can be applied to any type of sensor network, regardless of the number and type of sensors involved in the system and the complexity of the monitored environment, thus providing the analysts with a complete methodology for the development of these systems.
